method: WCAG sRGB relative luminance with channel threshold 0.04045 and contrast (lighter + 0.05)/(darker + 0.05). Alpha/color-mix composition is calculated in sRGB before luminance. Ratios retain Python double precision; no rounded pass/fail comparison.
limitations: No browser computed styles, rendered pixels, keyboard journeys, screen reader or native zoom were measured.
Gradient endpoints establish concrete failing declared color pairs; they do not locate actual text pixels within the rendered gradient.

Docs composition bounds assume the declared 18% accent selected-link tint over the body's declared 0–16% purple radial tint and opaque theme background; actual element geometry/gradient position is not measured.
Focus samples evaluate specified flat adjacent surfaces only, not clipping, full area, occlusion, contrast against images or every interactive state.
Status labels retain explicit words. Colored badge borders are decorative status reinforcement and are not treated as required control boundaries in these samples.
Forced-colors adjustment is not emulated or measured here. Existing solid outlines preserve a style that the user agent can recolor; browser acceptance remains deferred.

proposedSemanticFocus: Map shared --color-focus to --color-foreground by default; retain website's measured light focus override and deliberate light outline on the landing dark section. Light/dark/high-contrast theme switches must resolve the alias on the actual theme host.

motionCascadeFindings.detail: Shared .eh-button has explicit reduced-motion transition:none and hover transform:none; .eh-spinner animation:none. Badge foreground and 3px solid shared focus outline are also already repaired. Preserve these rather than re-implementing them.

packages/themes/src/styles/base.css applies 0.01ms durations, one animation iteration and scroll-behavior:auto using universal selectors with no !important. Later element/class rules can override these declarations. No animation-delay or transition-delay reset is present.

motionCascadeFindings.finding: Website document scrolling is already locally repaired
motionCascadeFindings.detail: reset.css declares html scroll-behavior:smooth; app.css later declares html scroll-behavior:auto within reduced motion. This website-specific override wins the earlier html rule. The base universal rule alone would lose to html.

motionCascadeFindings.finding: Store transitions have feature-level preference guards
motionCascadeFindings.detail: store.css disables transitions under .store-shell and separately removes hover artwork transforms. Keep necessary transform suppression when consolidating the duration/scroll policy.

Move the authoritative duration/delay/scroll preference override into themes/base.css with !important declarations; make ordinary smooth scrolling opt-in under prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference; retain explicit spinner and hover-transform behavior. Remove only the now-redundant website duration/scroll override. Test consuming stylesheet ordering without claiming browser execution.
